label: Carrier sense tags for discovery: case signature and agency tagged, modal frames left untagged
summary: Parameter-level sense tags (#1784, #1794) for the binders that truth discover identified across modules by name only (#1819, item 3). Input: the two discovery reports at e61946aa1 (next-tests limit 30, pool all; and the modal run of 24 targets, candidates 10). Together they list 354 distinct name-only binder pairs (findings, inner bridges and missing bridges): Being 112, Respect 96, W 38, σ 23, B 20, o 15, World 12, m 11, F 8, A 5, R 4, P 3, p 3, Time 3, Entity 1. Eight goals were filtered domain_by_name: run 1 t1, t4, t7, t8, t9, t10 (6 of 30 goals, not 7; the 7 in #1819 is a miscount) and modal t4 and t12. Their name-only binders are only σ, A, W and F. TAGGED. σ : TruthCore.Case.Catholicism.Signature and A : Agency σ (TruthCore.Case.Catholicism.StageThree.DivineFounding.Agency), with the new sense CASE_SIGNATURE_INTERPRETATION_1 (disambiguation fe91cc1f, definitions 0bc7c46e intended interpretation and d0c11dff schema model). No existing sense was about the signature as a whole: GOD_4 and CHURCH_VISIBLE_SOCIETY_AND_SPIRITUAL_COMMUNITY_1 tag single fields, and DEF-SKELETON-OPEN-PREDICATES only scopes the open stage predicates. That is why a sense was created. 160 statement declarations bind σ : Signature and 33 bind A : Agency σ (193 tags, in 27 modules across Case.Catholicism, StageThree, Alternatives.RevelationRecognition and ReligiousExperienceRecognition, Causality.DivineVeracity1410, DivineVeracityContent1410, NamingVeracityBatch1, NecessarySenseFork, TermSenseForks, DeiFiliusAttributeField, NecessaryClassicalGodRoot, SameSourceWitness, SpineRivalsAttributes, LogicalNecessityProfiles, Logic.Strength.NecessaryFrames and Logic.Inversions). Why they express one sense: the binder type is one structure whose fields already carry recorded senses, and each module docstring reads σ as the root's vocabulary. Each declaration is a case proposition, a rival or a negation of one (RevelationCapabilityRejected := ¬ RevelationPossibleAndRecognizable σ; EnvoyBridgeFails := ¬ EnvoyFoundingIsPrincipalsFounding σ A), so all are about the same intended interpretation. FoundingDefinitions.ImmediateOnlyReading binds _A, not A, and is not tagged. The 28 name-only σ/A pairs in the two reports are now all tag-identified. Other extension bundles over σ (Speech, Raising, Holding, Veracity, Assistance, Power, RecognitionProfile, Profile) stay untagged: they blocked no goal, and each needs its own reading. REFUSED. (1) Modal W/F (NecessaryIfExistent.ImpossibleExistence and NecessaryExistence vs S5Research.Universal; also the LogicalNecessityProfiles, ModalSenseSupport, ContingentBeingNode, NecessaryIfConnectivity and Explanation pairs). All are arbitrary Kripke frames (TruthCore.Modal.Frame) of stipulated research configurations. NecessaryIfExistent says that metaphysical adequacy is open, S5Research calls itself stipulated S5 experiments, and LimitationPossibility calls itself an analyst configuration. No record says that they interpret one intended accessibility relation, and DISAMB-NECESSARY keeps ten necessities apart, so a shared tag would assert an identification that no record states. Left untagged. Reopen with a sense record for the intended frame of metaphysical modality, with each module's frame read against it. (2) Being/Respect (208 pairs) and B, o, m, P, R, p, Time, World, Entity. They blocked no filtered goal. A Being carrier could take BEING_1 (being as the entity of a thing, DISAMB-BEING), but no sense record exists for Respect, and the respect carriers fix different constants (esse, motion, ...) per module. Tagging Being alone would unblock nothing, and a Respect sense needs its own definition and reading. Not decided here; listed as follow-up. MEASURED (scripts/run-discovery.sh on the PR head, pool all, the same candidate counts as before). Run 1 targets (6, candidates 8) before: filtered_by domain_by_name 6, known 3, senses 1, witness 3; 0 discoveries, 0 incompatibilities on these targets. After: domain_by_name 0, known 3, senses 1, witness 3; 1 discovery, 2 incompatibilities. Per goal: t1 ChristsChurchIsCatholicChurch stays filtered known (composes from argument e0e05aba). t4 EnvoyFoundingIsPrincipalsFounding stays filtered: known (argument 4e8e50bb) and senses (FOUNDED_BY_GOD_THROUGH_AN_ENVOY_1/2/3 without a bridge). t7 ChristFoundedVisibleChurch is now a certified DISCOVERY from Round3ChristChurch.CatholicChurchIsJesusFoundedVisibleSociety alone (∃-introduction at catholicChurch; axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; witness flag unresolved). t8 MandatedFoundingWithTeaching: now an INCOMPATIBILITY with core {FoundingScope.MandateCoversOnlyMessage, MessageReportBoundary.ActualMandatedCatholicFounding, CommissionAttestation.MessageRivalExcludedGivenFounding}. It unfolds MessageRivalExcludedGivenFounding at the witness of ActualMandatedCatholicFounding: the known exclusion of the message rival, not a new tension. t9 GodConfirmsOnlyTruth: now an INCOMPATIBILITY {EnvoyFoundingIsPrincipalsFounding, EnvoyBridgeFails}, a literal P/¬P pair (#1819 item 1 noise). t10 BridgeGodFoundedAuthorityProposesOnlyTruth stays filtered known (recorded rivals 5fc7a6f9/4640876a). Modal targets (2, candidates 10) before: domain_by_name 2, known 1. After: domain_by_name 1, known 1. t12 RootFactsForBearer stays filtered known (the same recorded rival pair), now without a name identification. t4 BackwardClosedAt is still filtered domain_by_name on W/F, as intended by refusal (1). Nothing is registered: the t7 discovery and both incompatibilities are listed for follow-up. No proof, binding, frontier or closure changes; frontier-diff against main reports no change.
